title: Harrison.ai Launches Harrison.Rad 2: A Unified Radiology Foundation Model
headline: Harrison.ai Releases Harrison.Rad 2 Radiology Foundation Model in Research Preview
summary: Harrison.ai has introduced Harrison.Rad 2, a unified foundation model capable of drafting clinical reports for 2D X-ray and 3D CT studies. The model features visual grounding to link written findings to specific image locations and is currently available in a research preview. Additionally, the company launched FrontierOS, an agentic reporting system already deployed in production by a teleradiology practice.
why_it_matters: The integration of visual grounding and human-in-the-loop verification features in clinical AI models highlights evolving standards for ensuring radiologist oversight and diagnostic accuracy in automated reporting workflows.

quotes.text: Harrison.Rad 2, launched in research preview today, represents a significant leap for radiology AI research and the future of patient care and diagnosis.

Rather than simply drafting reports, it introduces visual grounding, linking specific written statements directly to the corresponding location on the image so clinicians can quickly and accurately review findings.

classification.significance_reason: The release represents a technical advancement in clinical AI with specific features for human-in-the-loop verification, though it is currently in research preview.
